```{r Usefull Functions}
songExist <- function(string, artist){
    if (string %in% data$name){
        if (!is.null(artist)){
            songs <- data[data$name == string,]
            if (artist %in% songs$artists){
                return(TRUE)
            }
            print("Song doesn't exist with Artist(s)")
            return(FALSE)
        }
        return(TRUE)
    }
    print("Song doesn't exist")
    return(FALSE)
}

sameArtists <- function(artists){
    for (val in 1:(nrow(artists))){
        if (artists[val,]  %in% unname(unlist(artists[-val,]))){
            return(TRUE)
        }
    }
    return(FALSE)
}

addArtistWeight <- function(artists){
  song_artists <- str_split(artists, ", ")[[1]]
  data %>% 
    mutate(
      artist_cat = case_when(sapply(str_split(artists, ", "), function(x) x[[1]]) %in%                                        song_artists ~ 0,
                             TRUE ~ 1),
    ) %>% 
    return()
}
```

```{r}
descriptionBasic1 <- "Auto Generated Playlist that finds songs with closest euclidean distance to an input song '"
descriptionBasic2 <- "' based on 13 values provided from Spotify."

spotifyPlaylist <- function(string,  num = 20, artist = NULL){
    if (num > 100) {num = 100}
    if (num < 1) {num  = 1}
    if (!songExist(string, artist)) {return(FALSE)}
    inputSongData <- data[data$name == string,]
    inputSongData <- inputSongData[rowSums(is.na(inputSongData)) == 0,]
    if (!is.null(artist))
        inputSongData <- inputSongData[inputSongData$artists == artist,]
    if (nrow(inputSongData) > 1) {
        if (sameArtists(inputSongData["artists"]))
            inputSongData = inputSongData[1,]
        else {
            print("Multiple Artists please specify one of the following:")
            print(inputSongData$artists)
            return(FALSE)
        }
    }
    inputSongData["artist_cat"] <- 0
    datas <- addArtistWeight(inputSongData["artists"])
    song_artists <- str_split(inputSongData["artists"], ", ")[[1]]
    #distanceVec <- distancevector(as.matrix(datas[,seq(4,17)]),
               #          as.matrix(inputSongData[,seq(4,17)]), "euclid")
    distanceVec <- mahalanobis(datas[5:18], as.matrix(inputSongData[5:18]), cov(datas[5:18]))
    songDatas <- datas[,c(1,2,3)] %>% 
        mutate(distance = distanceVec) %>% 
        filter(name != inputSongData["name"]) %>% 
        mutate(
           distance = case_when(sapply(str_split(artists, ", "), function(x) x[[1]]) %in%                                        song_artists ~ distance,
                                  TRUE ~ distance + 2),
        ) %>% 
        arrange(distance) %>% 
        slice(1:num) %>% 
        distinct(name, artists, .keep_all=T)
    playlistName <- paste0("A.G.P. (", string, ")")
    playlistDesc <- paste0(descriptionBasic1, string, descriptionBasic2)
    playlist <- create_playlist(userID, playlistName, description = playlistDesc,
                authorization = get_spotify_authorization_code(scope = "playlist-modify-public"))
    add_tracks_to_playlist(playlist$id, paste0("spotify:track:",songDatas$id), 
                authorization = get_spotify_authorization_code(scope = "playlist-modify-public"))
    return(songDatas)
}
```


```{r row by row}
#Max 100 songs
vals <- spotifyPlaylist("Same Bitches (feat. G-Eazy & YG)", 50)
vals
```
